description: OpenTabs plugin for Microsoft Azure Portal

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Azure Portal user including email, display name, object ID, and tenant ID. Extracted from the MSAL session and ARM token.

tools.name: list_tenants
tools.description: List all Azure Active Directory tenants accessible to the current user. Returns tenant ID, display name, default domain, and category.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List all Azure subscriptions accessible to the current user. Returns subscription ID, display name, state, and tenant ID.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Azure subscription by its ID.

tools.name: list_resource_groups
tools.description: List all resource groups in an Azure subscription. Returns name, location, provisioning state, and tags.

tools.name: get_resource_group
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific resource group.

tools.name: create_resource_group
tools.description: Create a new resource group in an Azure subscription. Specify a name, location, and optional tags.

tools.name: delete_resource_group
tools.description: Delete a resource group and all resources within it. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. The operation is asynchronous — Azure begins deletion and returns immediately.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List all resources in a subscription or resource group. Use the filter parameter for OData filtering (e.g., "resourceType eq 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines'"). Optionally scope to a specific resource group.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Azure resource by its full resource ID. The resource ID follows the format: /subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/{rg}/providers/{provider}/{type}/{name}.

tools.name: delete_resource
tools.description: Delete a specific Azure resource by its full resource ID. This is a destructive and irreversible operation.

tools.name: list_resource_providers
tools.description: List all resource providers and their registration states for a subscription. Shows which providers are registered (available for use) vs not registered.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List all template deployments in a resource group. Returns deployment name, provisioning state, timestamp, and mode.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific template deployment in a resource group.

tools.name: create_deployment
tools.description: Create or update a template deployment in a resource group. Provide an ARM template and optional parameters. The deployment runs asynchronously.

tools.name: delete_deployment
tools.description: Delete a template deployment from a resource group. This removes the deployment history — it does not delete the deployed resources.

tools.name: list_activity_logs
tools.description: Query activity log events for a subscription. Use the filter parameter with OData syntax to filter by time range, resource group, or status. Example filter: "eventTimestamp ge '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' and eventTimestamp le '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'".

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List all available Azure regions/locations. Returns region name, display name, geography, and category (Recommended or Other). Does not require a subscription.

tools.name: list_subscription_locations
tools.description: List all available locations/regions for a specific subscription. These are the regions where resources can be deployed within the subscription.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tag names and values used in a subscription. Shows how many resources use each tag name and value combination.

tools.name: list_locks
tools.description: List all management locks in a subscription or resource group. Management locks prevent accidental deletion or modification of resources.

tools.name: create_lock
tools.description: Create a management lock on a resource group to prevent accidental deletion or modification. CanNotDelete prevents deletion but allows modifications. ReadOnly prevents all changes.

tools.name: delete_lock
tools.description: Delete a management lock from a resource group. This allows the previously locked operations to proceed.

tools.name: list_policy_assignments
tools.description: List all Azure Policy assignments for a subscription. Shows which policies are applied, their enforcement mode, and scope.

tools.name: get_policy_assignment
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Azure Policy assignment by name.

tools.name: list_role_assignments
tools.description: List all RBAC role assignments for a subscription. Shows which principals have which roles at which scopes. Use the filter to narrow by principal ID or role definition.
